subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Review Unit 2 words about climate change and the environment.
Use cause and effect connectors, compound nouns and will correctly.
Correct mistakes in sentences about the environment.

tf.s: Climate is the weather in one place over a long period of time.
tf.why: Yes! Weather is only about a short time.

tf.s: In 'Sea levels rise because of the melting ice', the melting ice is the cause.
tf.why: Correct, 'because of' comes before the cause.

tf.s: 'Greenhouse gas' and 'carbon footprint' are compound nouns.
tf.why: Right, each one is made of two words.

tf.s: Burning fossil fuels makes the planet cooler.
tf.why: It releases greenhouse gases, so the planet gets hotter.

tf.s: 'Plastic harm the ocean' is a correct sentence.
tf.why: The correct sentence is 'Plastic harms the ocean.'

tf.s: A topic sentence states the main idea of a paragraph.
An eco-friendly lifestyle harms the environment.
tf.why: Eco-friendly means not harmful to the environment.

tf.s: 'If we do nothing, sea levels will rise' is a prediction about the future.
In a debate, 'To sum up…' is used to introduce the first argument.
tf.why: 'To sum up' is used at the end to summarise.
